newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates narrow in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates narrow in liquid market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed on Thursday in a liquid private-sector market to between seven and 7-3/8 percent from seven and 8-1/2 percent on Wednesday, bankers said.

One-week rates slipped to between 7-3/8 and eight percent from 8-1/2 and 9-3/4 percent on Sunday. All bankers, polled by Reuters, said they had avoided one-week deals in the last three days because of the high liquidity.
They still cited a weak stock market and low t-bill rates as factors behind the accumulating liquidity in the money market.
Public-sector banks kept their rates at 10-1/2 percent.
